name: Rakazo
summary: Open-source Grok Bot alternative for persistent AI teammates that do real work, with your keys, your model and your machine.
description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative for persistent AI teammates that do real work, with your keys, your model and your machine.

pricing.details: Self-hosted Free (Apache-2.0), on your server or computer, any model you connect. Hosted Standard 14 €/month, or 11 €/month billed yearly, 7-day free trial, bot computer included. Pro 44 €/month. Max 90 €/month. Rakazo credits from 18 €/month (model usage at the provider’s price with no markup, plus computer hours). Hosted sandbox hours by plan: Standard 25 hours/month (4 vCPU/8 GB); Pro 100 hours/month (8 vCPU/16 GB); Max 200 hours/month (16 vCPU/32 GB).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Open-source AI teammates (Apache-2.0) with your keys, your model and your machine
MCP integrations (Gmail, GitHub, Notion and others), memory, schedules, webhooks and hand-offs
Skills learned by watching a task; optional hosted bot computer
Self-host for Free, or a 7-day hosted trial
